def factor_range_exp_rev_ewm_smooth(df):
    """Positive when large range with gap down and high volume predicts reversal, with EWM smoothing for stability."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    close = df_copy["close"]
    open_ = df_copy["open"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    range_ = high - low
    range_mean = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    range_std = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    range_z = (range_ - range_mean) / range_std.replace(0, np.nan)
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(close, open_)
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(volume, window=60)
    overnight_neg = np.clip(-overnight_ret, 0, None)
    range_z_clipped = np.maximum(range_z, 0)
    vol_weight = np.clip(vol_ratio, 0, 2) / 2
    raw_factor = overnight_neg * range_z_clipped * vol_weight
    # EWM smoothing to reduce noise
    smoothed_factor = raw_factor.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10).mean()
    smoothed_factor = smoothed_factor.fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_range_exp_rev_ewm_smooth"] = smoothed_factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_exp_rev_ewm_smooth"]
